instagram:
Small Business Relief didn't end in 2026.

Ministerial Decision No. 131 extends Small Business Relief to tax periods ending on or before 31 December 2029; the AED 3 million revenue threshold from Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023 continues to apply (UAE Ministry of Finance, 7 Aug 2026; checked 12 Nov 2026). Other conditions apply under Ministerial Decision No. 73 of 2023.

Revenue AED 3m or less this period
And in every earlier period since 1 June 2023
Elected in the corporate tax return
